changelog:
v4.2.16 — Live channels no longer spin forever

• If a live channel started loading but the stream never actually came through, the app used to sit on the spinner indefinitely — no reconnect, no message, nothing to do but back out and try again. That could go on for minutes.

• The app now watches live channels from the moment you tune in. If a stream stops delivering, it reconnects on its own, and if it still can't get the channel it tells you instead of leaving you staring at a spinner.

• Fixed a crash when tuning to a channel that carries Dolby 5.1 audio. The app would close itself while switching to the surround-sound decoder.

• If channels still won't play after this update, the problem is on the delivery side rather than the app — send a debug log from Settings and we can see exactly what the server is doing.

Includes everything from v4.2.15 and earlier: clearer messages for titles your provider hasn't uploaded, the fix for shows freezing mid-episode on Dolby titles, season and episode numbers on every screen, and the new logo.
